title: Semantic Scholar MCP Server
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing programmatic access to the Semantic Scholar academic graph (200M+ papers) — paper search, citation graph traversal, author profiles, recommendations, bulk retrieval, BibTeX export, and snippet search. 14 tools, MIT-licensed, distributed on PyPI as s2-mcp-server, on GitHub Container Registry, and in the Smithery MCP registry.
